records.description: The missing link between your GPU and Python AI libraries. Diagnose and fix CUDA version mismatches, validate Docker GPU configurations, and check AI model compatibility with your hardware.

records.name: SheetCDN
records.tagline: Your Google Sheets, now as a lightweight data API.
records.description: ✨ This is for you if: - You have an MVP that needs to read real data - You already use Google Sheets and want to expose it as an API - You're a UX designer and need dynamic data in your mockups - You want a lightweight backend without setting up heavy infrastructure 🎉Includes: - Full REST API per tab - CRUD operations with roles and permissions per endpoint - Authentication and encryption with HttpOnly - Self-managed rate limiting, caching, and CORS - Enhanced privacy and security for your data

records.name: Skin Thirst Moisturizing Cream
records.tagline: Skin Thirst: Lightweight Cream, Heavyweight Hydration
records.description: Skin Thirst is a lightweight yet deeply nourishing hyaluronic acid moisturizer crafted to replenish essential hydration and revive tired-looking skin. Powered by moisture-binding ingredients alongside soothing Witch Hazel and skin-conditioning Lecithin, this formula helps improve the appearance of uneven texture, fine lines, and visible pores. The result is skin that feels softer, smoother, and visibly refreshed with a naturally vibrant finish.

records.name: Lingotype
records.tagline: The diagnostic Duolingo never gave you 🦤
records.description: Most people open Duolingo, pick Spanish because everyone picks Spanish, and quit in 3 weeks. Not because they're lazy — because they chose the wrong language for how they think and what they actually want. Lingotype is a 9-question diagnostic that maps your learner archetype and tells you which language you're most likely to actually stick with — and how to study it. No streaks. No gamification. One result. One plan. One-time $2.99.

records.name: Nextish News
records.tagline: Make the AI news cycle slightly more ridiculous.
records.description: Nextish News turns your tech-world premise into a polished faux article with a headline, subtitle, sections, and a shareable public link. Built for group chats, Slack channels, and coworkers who read way too much funding news.

records.name: Talvet AI
records.tagline: The only AI Copilot to scale your brand on LinkedIn
records.description: Stop posting like a bot. Talvet is the AI Copilot built to scale your brand on LinkedIn without the AI cringe. While other tools generate generic noise, Talvet masters your unique professional voice to draft, design, and schedule quality content in seconds. Why Talvet? 🚀 Voice Mastery: AI that learns your specific writing style. 🔍 Lead Discovery: Find high-intent prospects through intelligent sourcing. 🧠 Inspiration Vault: Discover and curate winning formats, so you never start from zero.

records.name: OrchestrAI
records.tagline: AI agents to build and run your infrastructure all via chat
records.description: OrchestrAI helps startups run cloud, data, networking, cost, and security operations through one natural-language system with scoped access and live run visibility. From one time infrastructure build outs to continuous monitoring, OrchestrAI can help you take your startup from A to Z.

records.name: Cold Mail AI
records.tagline: Generate 5 personalized LinkedIn cold emails in 5 seconds
records.description: Stop wasting 2+ hours daily on manual LinkedIn personalization. Cold Mail AI uses Claude 3.5 Sonnet to analyze any profile and generate 5 unique email variations (Casual, Formal, Value-first, etc.) in just 5 seconds. I’m looking for my first 10 "Founders Circle" members! I’ll give a Free PRO License (300 emails/day) to the first 10 people who test it and leave feedback here. Let’s make outreach human again.

records.name: ChatGPT for Personal Finance
records.tagline: Personal finance guidance powered by ChatGPT
records.description: A preview for Pro users: a new personal finance experience in ChatGPT. Pro users in the U.S. can securely connect financial accounts, see where their money is going, and ask questions based on the information they choose to connect. Your full financial picture, now in ChatGPT.

records.name: Autosprites AI Studio
records.tagline: AI Tools for 2D Game Development
records.description: Build game art at the speed of thought. AI-powered sprite generation, animation, and asset tools for game developers.

records.name: Incultnito Studio
records.tagline: Brief-first apparel workflow with a public fulfillment MCP
records.description: Write one brief. We generate print-ready art, composite it on garments, and route the order through Printful or your factory webhook today. 4 more adapters in queue. Public MCP, 275 tests. Solo non-coder, all Claude-paired.
